description.text: One of the two tenth expansions of the Sword & Shield series, released together with Space Juggler on 8 April 2022, with Pokémon of the Hisui region, some in their Hisuian forms, and the Origin Formes of Dialga and Palkia. Time Gazer holds Origin Forme Dialga VSTAR, whose VSTAR Power attack Star Chronos does 220 damage and gives its player another turn, with the Supporter Adaman, which discards Metal Energy to take any two cards from the deck. Hisuian Lilligant VSTAR, whose VSTAR Power takes up to five Grass Pokémon or Grass Energy from the deck, Machamp VMAX, Luxray V, Jirachi V, Wyrdeer V, Hisuian Typhlosion and Magnezone join it, with the Supporters Gardenia's Vigor and Zisu. The two packs brought Pokémon VMAX back after Star Birth and Battle Region. Packs held five cards. The cards are numbered to 67, followed by full-art Super Rare Pokémon V and Supporters, some Pokémon V in a second version drawn as a full scene, rainbow Hyper Rare Pokémon VSTAR, Machamp VMAX and Supporters, and gold Ultra Rare Origin Forme Dialga VSTAR, Trekking Shoes and Path to the Peak. In English many of its cards came out in Astral Radiance in May 2022, and some in Lost Origin in September 2022.
